assumptions: Satellite-informed reconstruction, not a survey or an exact digital twin.
Building footprints, road lines, water outlines and wood polygons come from OSM.
Visible roof palettes and landcover distributions follow satellite observations. Unrecorded heights, facades, roof forms and exact tree trunks remain approximate.
Macro relief uses Terrain Tiles. River water is levelled and banks are blended for presentation.
The OSM boundary is not cadastral. Recorded gates are candidates; the main entrance is unconfirmed.
No Yandex satellite imagery or photos are redistributed in the model.

detail_method: OSM building footprints and mapped fences. Satellite-derived roof colours, semantic ground cover and approximate canopy centres. Unverified Voronoi plots, random greenhouses and garden beds removed. Facades and porches remain inferred. Exterior-specific profiles for 116 and 3с1; provisional 126/126с2 match; 128 text-only profile. Roof forms, UV orientation, gutters, frames and entrance details reconstructed. Road corridors retain OSM positions with inferred gravel shoulders and wheel wear. Vegetation preserved exactly. September 12: 205 SNT footprints visually screened; 8 hip and 2 flat roofs interpreted individually. Exact OSM wall vertices preserved without simplification. Roof facets split at every slope break. Photo-specific plinths, cladding, entrance trim and equipment are approximate reconstructions. Footprint mismatches are recorded, not silently corrected.

satellite_review.canopy_method: Roof observations plus semantic vegetation/ground classification; OSM masks. Crown centres and heights approximate.
